## What We Do

Maroogr provides a guaranteed rent, fully managed company let service for landlords. We rent your property on a long-term basis, pay you a fixed rent every month, and host vetted short- to mid-term guests — primarily working professionals and contractors.

---

## How It Works

- You grant us a company let agreement for an agreed term (typically 3–5 years).
- We pay you a **fixed monthly rent**, whether the property is occupied or not.
- We handle all marketing, bookings, guest communication and check-ins.
- We arrange regular professional cleaning and periodic inspections.
- We deal with maintenance issues up to **£300 per issue** before involving you.

---

## Benefits For You

### Guaranteed Rent
- Fixed rent paid every month for the full term.
- No void periods — your income is not tied to occupancy.

### Hands-Off Management
- We manage guests, cleaners and day-to-day issues entirely.
- No tenant calls, chasing late rent, or organising viewings.

### Property Looked After
- Regular professional cleans and inspections keep the property in excellent condition.
- Wear-and-tear issues are handled promptly.

### No Management Fees
- You receive the agreed rent in full — no deductions.
- Our income comes from how we run the property, not from charging you fees.

---

## Who Stays In The Property?

We host **working professionals, contractors and corporate guests** on short- to mid-term stays.

- No parties, events or large group bookings.
- All guests are vetted and must agree to our strict house rules.
- Guests are held accountable for damage or rule breaches.

---

## Responsibilities at a Glance

| **Landlord** | **Maroogr** |
|---|---|
| Maintain building insurance and mortgage as normal | Pay the agreed rent on time every month |
| Cover major structural works (roof, boiler replacement, etc.) | Cover utilities and council tax during the agreement term |
| Approve any material changes to the property | Manage all guests, cleaners and day-to-day issues |
| | Cover repairs up to £300 per issue |
| | Keep the property clean and well presented at all times |

---

## Compliance & Professionalism

Maroogr operates as a professional accommodation provider and meets all relevant legal and safety requirements for the properties we manage. We work exclusively with qualified tradespeople and trusted cleaning contractors. You are welcome to review our agreement in full and seek independent legal advice before committing — we encourage it.

We are members of **PIMS**, a dispute resolution scheme for rent-to-rent operators (membership no. **137545**), providing you with additional protection and peace of mind.
